description: The plot illustrates how a performance metric varies with different chunking sizes (token counts) for four source types: Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Tokens” and uses a linear scale, spanning approximately 200 to 1000 tokens, with labeled ticks at 200-token intervals (200, 400, 600, 800). The y-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 10 to 40 with major ticks every 10 units (10, 20, 30, 40). The Tutorials series is a solid blue line with circular markers, rising from about 23 at 200 tokens to about 27 at 500 and about 29 at 800, then slightly decreasing to about 28–29 at the rightmost point (~1000). The Library Documentation series is a solid red line with circular markers, increasing from about 26 at 200 to about 29 at 500 and about 32 at 800, then dropping to about 27–28 at the rightmost point. The Github files series is a solid green line with circular markers, moving from about 28 at 200 to about 30 at 500 and peaking around 33 at 800, then declining to about 30 at the rightmost point. The StackOverflow posts series is a solid yellow line with circular markers, decreasing from about 33 at 200 to about 30 at 500, then dropping more sharply to about 19 at 800 and reaching about 11–12 at the rightmost point.
